title: introduce-tenant-hook-policy-and-multi-phase-seed-jobs
author: Aisha Kumar
release_notes: Add tenant-scoped hook policy and new multi-phase seed/init job orchestration for private installs; includes values schema changes and backward-compatible flags for air-gapped and dry-run installs.
description:
Context and motivation: Private installs need better isolation and resilience during initial seeding and schema migrations. Operators deploying Redwood in VPC/on-prem clusters requested a safer, tenant-scoped hook policy and the ability to run multi-phase seed jobs with explicit failure/backoff semantics, especially for air-gapped environments where network fallbacks are limited. This PR introduces a composable hook policy and a multi-phase seeding template that decouples preflight, seed, and postflight phases and enables per-tenant timeouts, concurrency controls, and conditional migration steps.

Summary of changes: - New values schema section: .global.hookPolicy and .tenants[].hookPolicy that allow per-tenant override of lifecycle behavior, backoff windows, and concurrency. - Multi-phase seed job templates: templates/seed-phase-00-preflight.yaml, templates/seed-phase-10-seed.yaml, templates/seed-phase-20-postflight.yaml. Each phase supports dryRun and tenant-scoped annotations. - Hook controller helpers: _helpers.tpl additions to render policy annotations and leader-election safeguards. - Conditional migration blocks in templates/migration-job.yaml guarded by values.enableConditionalMigrations to support air-gapped installs. - Add a values example file values.examples/tenant-hook-policy.yaml and document the expected upgrade path in NOTES.txt. - Unit tests for template rendering in charts/test/templates and a small Bats fixture used by CI for helm template validations.

Why this approach: Splitting the seed lifecycle into explicit phases makes rollback safer (we can resume or skip idempotent phases), allows targeted retries with exponential backoff, and reduces blast radius for tenant-scoped failures. A separate hook policy object keeps the helm values declarative and easier to audit for enterprise compliance teams.

Compatibility and upgrade notes: - Defaults preserve existing behavior unless .global.hookPolicy or a tenant override is provided. - For clusters using previous charts: migrations are opt-in via enableConditionalMigrations=false by default; operators are advised to run a dry-run of the seed phases before enabling automatic migration. - Added a compatibility shim that maps old initHook.* values into the new structure when not explicitly set.

Testing performed: - Local helm template rendering against k8s 1.26 and 1.27 with and without tenant overrides. - Integration: ran the multi-phase seed sequence in a vagrant-based air-gapped e2e environment (tags: e2e/airgap) and verified proper backoff behavior after artificially induced failures. - CI: lint and template-check passed; a flaky unit test was fixed and rerun. CI artifacts: helm-template-report.html and bats-output.log attached to the pipeline.

Review conversation (high level): - Marco Alvarez (requested changes 2026-02-19): "Please add an explicit leader-elector annotation to all init jobs to avoid thundering herds during simultaneous installs; also prefer shorter default backoff for quick-fixable failures."
Author (reply 2026-02-19): "Added leader-elector annotation and made backoff configurable via hookPolicy.backoff.windowMs with a conservative default of 15s; updated tests."
- Sophie Chen (comment 2026-02-20): "Can we avoid introducing a new top-level values block where possible? How about namespacing under init or preflight to keep values surface smaller?"
Author (reply 2026-02-20): "I moved the tenant-scoped policy under .global.hookPolicy and .tenants[].hookPolicy to keep a single entry point; documented the rationale in NOTES.txt."
- Jamal Thompson (approved 2026-02-23): "Verified templates in our staging cluster; RBAC matrix looks good and migration guard works as intended. Approving."

CI summary: - GitHub Actions: helm-lint -> pass, template-check -> pass, bats-integration -> pass after one rerun. - Internal gating: security-scan -> pass, license-check -> pass.

Merge details: merged via squash on 2026-02-24 by Marco Alvarez. Changelog entry added to Chart.yaml and NOTES.txt. Rollout: plan to flip enableConditionalMigrations=true in a staged rollout for a single large-customer namespace next week behind a feature flag and monitor seed job success rates and init job error counts.
